faq: Is Gurdevjit a registered migration agent?
Yes. Gurdevjit Singh's MARN is 2016337. You can check it on the official OMARA register.
What does the first consultation cost?
$220. It includes a document checklist and an assessment of your prospects, and the fee is credited to your total service fee if you go ahead with lodgement.
Do I need to come to the office?
No. Noble Visa works by phone, email, WhatsApp and Zoom. Office visits in Noble Park North are by appointment.
Can you help with student health cover?
Noble Visa partners with nib, Allianz and Bupa health insurance.
